tutorials.title: Start Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to playing Rune Factory 4.
tutorials.text:
# GAMENAME Setup Guide

## What you need
- Bizhawk https://tasvideos.org/BizHawk/ReleaseHistory#Bizhawk210
- The latest APNAME.apworld provided in the latest release post


## Installation
Same as every other unsupported GAMESYSTEM apworld, 
- simply move APNAME.apworld into the custom_worlds directory in your Archipelago install server
(default path: C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\custom_worlds)
- or simply double click the apworld and it should install itself (Archipelago version 0.5.0 and later)

## Running
1. In the Archipelago launcher push the 'Generate Template Options' button to generate a yaml for your options
2. Like every other apworld, fill out your yaml options and have the host generate the multiworld, the produced zip file should contain a .PATCHEXT patch file. Receive this .PATCHEXT patch from the multiworld host.
3. Push the 'Open Patch' button in the launcher and it should ask for a 'GAMENAME (US)' legal ROM dump (MD5 Hash: HASH), then select the generated  .PATCHEXT patch file to produce a .GAMEEXT ROM which should auto launch in a bizhawk instance. You should be set otherwise from here just follow the same instructions as any other supported GAMESYSTEM apworld.

## Troubleshooting
- The windows 7 version of archipelago uses python 3.8 which will not work with this apworld.

readme.text: # Setup Guide ## Necessary Software: [Archipelago Latest Release](https://github.com/Happyhappyism/Rune-Factory-4-Archipelago/releases) RF4S APworld `rune4.apworld` ## Setup steps: - Create a folder named "Archipelago" in your Rune Factory 4 Special install directory. It should look something like the picture below. - Install the RF4S AP world (This can be done by simply double clicking the apworld wherever you downloaded it to. If it asks for a program to open it with, choose the Archipelago launcher.) - Open your AP launcher and select "Generate Template files", which will make your RF4S Template and open your template folder. - Set up your yaml, and when done, place it into your "players" folder, then generate your game (or send the yaml to the person that will be hosting if you'll be playing a multiworld.) - Generate your game. - In the output zip from generation, there will be a save marked with your chosen player name. Place that save into the Archipelago folder we made in your install directory. If you have Trupin hints enabled, also place your hints.json file in the same Rune Factory 4 Special\Archipelago folder as well. - Run the RF4S Client from the AP launcher. This will prompt you for the paths to your install folder. - Once given the right paths, the client will automatically generate your save, and open RF4S. From there, you need only connect to your server and play the game. ## Additional Setup for Linux Users https://github.com/arryndoestech/Rune-Factory-4-Linux-Archipelago # Randomizations ## Goals - Ethelberd - Rune Prana - Shipment Percentage - Nationalize Baths (untested) - Rune Hunt - Homeowner (untested) - Marriage (Shipping white stone, untested) - Custom (Any specific location as a goal) - Eliza ## Items - Area Access items - Crafting Licenses - Special Quality of Life items - Progressive Equipment ## Locations - Shipments - Crops (normal/large/gold) - Drops - Crafts - Forge - Crafting Table - Dishes - Potions - Minerals - Groceries - Spells - Chests - Monster Taming - Friendship Levels - Outfit Purchases - Barriersanity - Boxsanity ## Options - Deathlink - Mistress Trupin Hints - Starting Weapon - Music/Sound Effect Randomization - Monster Randomization (Sometimes unstable) - Changing Character Appearance - Shuffle Spell Elements ## Quality of Life - Exp/Skill Exp multipliers - Drop Rate Boosting - No Jones Fee - Show Enemy HP/Level ## Planned Features - Requestsanity ## Credits ### Coding - Happyhappyism - [Arryndoestech](https://github.com/arryndoestech) ### Spreadsheet Mapping - Caidyrn - Tilemon - Prelude ### Poptracker Pack - [rdpeake](https://github.com/rdpeake/rune4-poptracker) ### Testing - Caidyrn - Noa - Maki - Prelude
